name: Tic-Tac-Toe — enforced
description: Three in a row wins. Unlike a free table, the engine enforces this one: it only lets you place your own mark, only on your turn, only on an empty square — and it calls the win.

place.reason: Play your own mark, on an empty square, on your turn.

rules.objective: Be first to line up three of your marks — across, down, or diagonally.
howToPlay: On your turn, drag your mark onto an empty square — it snaps into place.
The board is strict: it refuses the opponent's mark, occupied squares, and out-of-turn plays.
Turns advance automatically after each legal move.
rules.winning: Three in a row wins. A full board with no line is a draw. Use Menu ▸ Clear the board to play again.
